title: Ticket attachments
bodyMarkdown:
## Why
Agents keep asking customers to e-mail screenshots.

## Acceptance Criteria
- AC1: Uploads larger than 10 MB are rejected with HTTP 413.
- AC2: Only PNG, JPEG and PDF files are accepted. Other types get HTTP 415.
- AC3: A file is scanned for viruses before it becomes downloadable. Infected files are rejected.
- AC4: The stored object key is generated by the server. The file name sent by the client is never used as a path.

The scanner is the existing internal service behind ScanClient.scan(buffer).
